Container.Name: commander-forge
Container.Overview: Commander Forge: a Magic: The Gathering Commander deckbuilder. Pick a commander, gameplan, bracket and budget, get synergy-ranked cards with write-ups using live Scryfall, EDHREC and Commander Spellbook data, keep your card collection, playtest, and export to Archidekt or Moxfield. AI recommendations use Google Gemini (free tier works) or an Anthropic API key, which you can set here or in the app.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Your collection, saved builds, settings and the card-data cache (one SQLite file).

Config.Name: Gemini API key
Config.Description: Optional. You can also paste it in the app under AI engine. Free key: aistudio.google.com/apikey

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: Optional. Use Claude instead of Gemini. Key: console.anthropic.com

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: Optional: gemini or anthropic. Leave blank to choose in the app.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the app asks for this password (any username) before opening.
